title: A rescaled cubic certificate for a fixed full-B2 sumset family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let h(n)=n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent with the exact parameters in guarantee.remainder. There exist a fixed real K>0 and N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-K*h(n) for every integer n>=N. K is existential, not a specified coefficient. claims: Eventually proof.md's one fixed cubic-certificate evaluator is a disperser for the support of X_1+X_2 whenever X_1,X_2 are independent n-bit sources of min-entropy at least H*ceil(log2(n+1)), under its stated finite guards. In particular it is nonconstant on every affine flat of that dimension, and the supplied ordinary native bridge proves the declared full-B2 bound.
